target.projectDescription: Ethyca Fides (setup.py name 'ethyca-fides'; version via versioneer from git - the CHANGELOG shows the tree is on main after 2.15.0, database creation sha 1212eadf) - a privacy-engineering platform: a FastAPI 0.89.1 webserver (src/fides/api) with a Click CLI (src/fides/cli), a client library layer (src/fides/core), Celery workers, and non-Python frontends under clients/ (admin-ui, privacy-center - outside this python database). Path-traversal-relevant architecture: (1) the admin-UI static file serving channel - src/fides/api/main.py:154-197 registers a catchall route @app.get("/{catchall:path}") whose handler read_other_paths reads path = request.path_params["catchall"] at :160, resolves it via match_route(get_ui_file_map(), path) at :163 (a regex-anchored route map built from .glob('**/*.html') over the packaged admin UI directory, ui.py:82), falls back to get_path_to_admin_ui_file(path) at :167 (ui.py:32-42: package_path / ADMIN_UI_DIRECTORY / path - a pathlib __truediv__ chain in which an ABSOLUTE user path REPLACES the entire base and '..' segments are kept lexically), checks ui_file.is_file() at :170, guards with path_is_in_ui_directory(ui_file) at :171 (ui.py:134-141: `ui_directory in path.parents` - a LEXICAL containment check on the UNRESOLVED path, which passes for paths like <ui_dir>/../../etc/passwd because the lexical parents list still contains <ui_dir>), and finally serves FileResponse(ui_file) at :180 (the starlette-side open is external to this database). No resolve()/realpath, no '..' rejection, no basename extraction, and no percent-decoding in fides' own code (starlette decodes the URL path before routing). (2) the zip template upload channel - src/fides/api/api/v1/endpoints/saas_config_endpoints.py:358-388 register_custom_connector_template takes a raw application/zip body (file: bytes = Body(...)), parses it with ZipFile(BytesIO(file), 'r') at :378 and CustomConnectorTemplateLoader.save_template (connector_registry_service.py:178-283) reads entries via zip_file.read(info) at :191 using info.filename only for endswith('config.yml'/'dataset.yml'/'.svg'/'.py') selection - ALL IN MEMORY (BytesIO), nothing is extracted to the filesystem; the .py entry content additionally reaches register_custom_functions/exec (connector_registry_service.py:445-482, RestrictedPython-gated, PASS 4 material, not pass 1). (3) the local upload write channel - src/fides/api/tasks/storage.py:172-190 upload_to_local builds filename = f"fides_uploads/{file_key}" at :184 where file_key = f"{privacy_request.id}.{ext}" (storage_uploader_service.py:67-75 - server-generated request id, NOT request-controlled) and writes it with open(filename, 'wb') at :187 after os.makedirs at :182. (4) the DSR report channel - dsr_report_builder.py builds an in-memory zip (zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO) at :41, writestr member names f"/{dataset_name}/{collection_name}/{index}.html" derived from graph dataset keys at :83/:93/:99/:116/:128) and reads one packaged asset via Path(os.path.join(DSR_DIRECTORY, 'assets/back.svg')).read_text() at :150. (5) the config/CLI channels - config loading via toml.load(getenv-config path) (config/__init__.py:197-202), load_file searching FIDES__CONFIG_PATH/cwd/parent/home (config/helpers.py:15-47), packaged SaaS template reads (saas_util.py load_yaml_as_string/load_config/load_as_string/load_datasets/encode_file_contents, connector_registry_service.py:73-100 os.listdir/os.path.join over data/saas), consent notice yaml reads (consent_util.py:511/:560 via load_file), and the Click CLI (fides_dir/manifests_dir/input_filename/output_filename/keyfile_path/env_file parameters flowing into manifest write/read, credentials write/read, config write, keyfile read) - all operator-trust level. FastAPI, starlette, pathlib, zipfile, fideslang, toml and RestrictedPython are external libraries not present in this CodeQL database (the 145882-LOC baseline covers the fides repo only).

inputBoundaryInventory.summary: fides is a FastAPI webserver + Click CLI + Celery workers, so the untrusted-input boundaries are: (1) the catchall route path variable - @app.get("/{catchall:path}") injects the entire decoded request path into read_other_paths as request.path_params["catchall"] (main.py:160), which drives the admin-UI static file resolution (match_route -> get_path_to_admin_ui_file -> is_file -> path_is_in_ui_directory -> FileResponse); (2) request header reads (request.headers.get: X-Fides-Source analytics, UNESCAPE_SAFESTR_HEADER consent-notice flags, User-Agent/Referer consent reporting, content-type yaml gate, authorization audit middleware, plus the bare request.headers read at privacy_preference_endpoints.py:242); (3) request body readers (await request.body() in the audit-log middleware and the YAML dataset PATCH endpoint); (4) the raw application/zip upload body (file: bytes = Body(...) of register_custom_connector_template - the only file-upload endpoint; parsed in memory, never extracted to disk); (5) request.url/url.path/url.hostname/method/client/scope reads (analytics and audit middleware - not file-targeting, recorded for completeness); (6) the 176 typed CRUD routes take Pydantic body/query models (the standard API channel - config/secrets/identity data flows into the DB and outbound connectors, no observed flow into local filesystem paths; not emitted per-field, see uncoveredCases); (7) environment variables (FIDES__CONFIG_PATH, FIDES_CREDENTIALS_PATH) and the config file they select - operator trust level; (8) the Click CLI (fides_dir, manifests_dir, input_filename, output_filename, keyfile_path, env_file command parameters flowing into manifest/config/credentials/keyfile reads and writes) - operator trust level; (9) the Celery task payload boundary (server-generated privacy request ids, ORM state). The sink side funnels through: FileResponse (the actual static file serve), pathlib path construction and lexical containment (ui.py get_path_to_admin_ui_file's `/` chain, path_is_in_ui_directory's `in path.parents`), builtin open() (12 sites: local upload write, config/credentials/manifest/keyfile/notice-yaml/saas-template reads and writes), os.makedirs/os.mkdir, os.path.join/isfile/exists/abspath, os.listdir/.iterdir/.glob/glob.glob, in-memory zipfile (ZipFile ctor, writestr member names, zip entry reads), fideslang manifest write/read (write_manifest, ingest_manifests, load_yaml_into_dict), toml.load config read, .read_text on a packaged asset, and the internal path-taking wrapper definitions (load_file, load_config, upload_to_local, get_path_to_admin_ui_file, match_route, path_is_in_ui_directory, write/read credentials, get_manifest_list, ...).

guardsAndEvidence.evidence: main.py:154-197 read_other_paths: path = request.path_params["catchall"] (:160); ui_file = match_route(get_ui_file_map(), path) (:163 - the route map keys are regex patterns anchored ^...$ built from relative_paths of globbed UI files, so match_route VALUES are always files physically inside the packaged UI dir); fallback ui_file = get_path_to_admin_ui_file(path) (:167 -> ui.py:42 package_path / ADMIN_UI_DIRECTORY / path - pathlib keeps '..' segments lexically and an ABSOLUTE path replaces the base entirely); then ui_file.is_file() (:170) and path_is_in_ui_directory(ui_file) (:171 -> ui.py:134-141: `return ui_directory in path.parents`) - the containment check is computed on the UNRESOLVED lexical path: for a candidate like <ui_dir>/../../etc/passwd the parents list is [<ui_dir>/../../etc, <ui_dir>/../.., <ui_dir>/.., <ui_dir>, ...], so <ui_dir> IS a member and the guard PASSES while the OS resolves the path outside the UI directory.
